- **Falcons signed ED Bralen Trice (Free Agent Signing)**

- **Eagles signed QB Joe Milton III (Free Agent Signing)**

- **Falcons added DB Jammie Robinson (Practice Squad Veteran)**

- **Ravens signed LB Carl Jones (Free Agent Signing)**  
  Strengthens linebacker depth; likely a depth or special-teams look.

- **Chargers signed ED Caleb Murphy (Free Agent Signing)**  
  Adds another edge rusher to the rotation and practice/roster competition.

- **Bears placed ED Dayo Odeyingbo on Reserve/Injured**  
  Removes a pass-rush piece from the active roster and opens a roster spot.

- **Packers placed DL Javon Hargrave on Reserve/Injured**  
  Major defensive-line loss; Green Bay will need to replace interior pass rush/run defense reps.

- **Titans waived DB Erick Hallett (Waived, No Recall)**  
  Cuts a defensive-back depth piece; he’s now available to other teams.

- **Texans waived LB Aiden Fisher (Waived, No Recall)**  
  Moves Houston on from a linebacker depth player and frees a roster spot.

- **Texans waived DB Collin Wright (Waived, No Recall)**  
  Another secondary depth move; Houston trims the defensive backfield.

- **Bears terminated DB Xavier Woods (Vested Veteran, all contracts)**  
  Clears a roster spot in the secondary; Chicago loses an experienced defender.

- **Chargers terminated WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling (Vested Veteran, all contracts)**  
  Opens receiver roster space and removes a veteran deep threat from the Chargers.
